description: The file defines a function `marshalProtocolVersionFromSapi` that extracts and returns the HTTP protocol version from the server variables array, handling exceptions if the protocol version is malformed.

classes.name: Exception\UnrecognizedProtocolVersionException
classes.description: Custom exception class thrown when the server protocol version is unrecognized or malformed.

methods.name: marshalProtocolVersionFromSapi
methods.description: Retrieves the HTTP protocol version from the server array, defaulting to '1.1' if not set, or throwing an exception if the format is invalid.
